name: Integrational e.V.
description: Integrational e.V. is a German non-profit organisation committed to promoting European cooperation, youth empowerment, civic engagement, and sustainable digital practices. As project coordinator for Green Horizon, Integrational e.V. oversees general project governance, quality assurance, transnational coordination, and financial administration.
keyResponsibilities: Overall project coordination and financial management
Coordination of transnational meetings and monitoring framework
Organization of Transnational Drone Operation & Digital Storytelling Training Course
Leading evaluation, monitoring and sustainability reporting

name: Yenilikçi Eğitim Bilim ve Sanat Derneği (IESA)
description: Yenilikçi Eğitim Bilim ve Sanat Derneği (Innovative Education, Science and Art Association) is a forward-thinking youth organisation focused on STEAM education, digital youth work, creative media, and youth climate advocacy. In Green Horizon, IESA leads the technological curriculum, drone educational modules, and digital production standards.
keyResponsibilities: Co-development of Educational Booklet on Drone Tech & Climate Storytelling
Coordination of local workshops and field missions in Türkiye
Technical mentorship in aerial photography, drone flight safety, and video post-production
Facilitating youth-led climate documentary production in Anatolian river basins

name: Asociația Empower Plus
description: Asociația Empower Plus is a Romanian non-governmental organisation dedicated to community empowerment, social inclusion, environmental activism, and experiential youth education. In Green Horizon, Empower Plus leads dissemination strategies, local youth outreach, and the hybrid Virtual Reality (VR) climate exhibition.
keyResponsibilities: Curation and technical launch of the 360° Virtual Climate Photo Exhibition
Implementation of Romanian regional youth workshops and field documentation missions
Design of the Dissemination & Exploitation Strategy across European youth networks
Hosting transnational dissemination events and local community screenings
